features.name: linear_combination_primary
features.description: Weighted linear combination of x1 through x5, approximating a hyperplane projection in the first five dimensions. Weights decrease geometrically to emphasize earlier features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth linear projection that SVM can use directly as a margin-relevant feature, capturing dominant variance directions.

features.name: linear_combination_secondary
features.description: Weighted linear combination of x6 through x10, approximating a hyperplane projection in the last five dimensions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures variance in the secondary feature block, complementing the primary projection for SVM margin separation.

features.name: l2_norm_all
features.description: L2 norm of all 10 features, measuring the Euclidean distance from the origin in the full feature space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a radial distance measure that helps SVM identify decision boundaries based on distance from origin.

features.name: sum_odd_features
features.description: Sum of odd-indexed features (x1, x3, x5, x7, x9), capturing the combined signal from alternating feature dimensions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates odd-indexed features into a single score, potentially aligning with separating hyperplanes in the 2dplanes dataset.

features.name: sum_even_features
features.description: Sum of even-indexed features (x2, x4, x6, x8, x10), capturing the combined signal from alternating feature dimensions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates even-indexed features into a single score, complementing the odd-feature sum for linear separation.

features.name: odd_even_difference
features.description: Difference between sum of odd-indexed and even-indexed features, capturing the contrast between two feature groups.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights directional contrast between feature groups, which can be a strong linear discriminant for SVM.

features.name: x1_x2_interaction
features.description: Product of x1 and x2, capturing the interaction between the two most prominent features. Normalized by dividing by 2 to keep range bounded.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures bilinear interaction between x1 and x2, providing a non-linear signal that can improve linear SVM separation.

features.name: mean_absolute_deviation
features.description: Mean absolute value of all 10 features, measuring average feature magnitude across all dimensions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized measure of overall feature activity, useful for SVM to distinguish high-magnitude from low-magnitude regions.
features.formula: (np.abs(x1) + np.abs(x2) + np.abs(x3) + np.abs(x4) + np.abs(x5) + np.abs(x6) + np.abs(x7) + np.abs(x8) + np.abs(x9) + np.abs(x10)) / 10.0

features.name: x1_sign_weighted_sum
features.description: Sum of all features weighted by the sign of x1, creating a directional projection aligned with x1's orientation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a sign-conditioned projection that can capture asymmetric decision boundaries aligned with x1's direction.

features.name: feature_range_spread
features.description: Difference between maximum and minimum feature values across all 10 dimensions, measuring the spread of feature values within a row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures intra-row feature spread, which can indicate whether a point lies in a homogeneous or heterogeneous region of feature space.
features.formula: np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(x1, x2), np.maximum(x3, x4)), np.maximum(np.maximum(x5, x6), np.maximum(x7, x8))), np.maximum(x9, x10)) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(x1, x2), np.minimum(x3, x4)), np.minimum(np.minimum(x5, x6), np.minimum(x7, x8))), np.minimum(x9, x10))

features.name: quadrant_indicator_score
features.description: Semantic score estimating which quadrant of the feature space a point occupies based on the signs and magnitudes of x1 and x2. Score ranges from -1 (both strongly negative) to 1 (both strongly positive), with intermediate values for mixed signs.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth quadrant-based score that helps SVM identify decision boundaries in the x1-x2 plane, which is often the primary separating plane in 2dplanes datasets.

features.name: feature_coherence_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of how coherent or aligned the feature values are across all 10 dimensions. High score (near 1) indicates features are mostly same-signed and large in magnitude; low score (near -1) indicates features are mostly opposite-signed or near zero, suggesting incoherence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the overall directional coherence of the feature vector, which can serve as a smooth discriminant for SVM when decision boundaries correlate with feature alignment patterns.
